<p style="text-align: justify;">We are a member of <a href="https://www.charta-der-vielfalt.de/en/" target="_blank">Charta der Vielfalt</a> and are dedicated to actively fostering a workplace that celebrates and promotes diversity in various aspects such as age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or cognitive ability, and ethnicity. At MOIA, we embrace a culture where people are accepted, respected, valued, appreciated, and included.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">In our commitment to promoting diversity and inclusivity, we regularly provide unconscious bias training to all our employees. Furthermore, we continuously strive to enhance our hiring process by ensuring a diverse hiring panel.</p> <h2 style="text-align: justify;">How we work</h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">At MOIA, our teams are typically distributed across our office locations and collaborate in a hybrid setup. We work together both remotely and on site, choosing the mode of collaboration that fits the context, the work at hand, and each team’s rhythm.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">Spending time together in our offices is an important part of how we stay connected, build trust, and solve complex problems. At the same time, we value flexibility and give teams and individuals autonomy to shape their ways of working, with everyone having the freedom to organise their routines in a way that aligns with their work and their team’s needs.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">If you’d like to learn more about how we work, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://moiadev.medium.com/" target="_blank">our blog</a> for insights into our culture and <a href="https://moiadev.medium.com/how-we-hire-at-moia-a-look-inside-our-hiring-process-da86b45016a5" target="_blank">hiring process</a>, or follow us on <a href="https://www.instagram.com/lifeatmoia/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> for a look behind the scenes at MOIA.</p> <h2 style="text-align: justify;">Who we are</h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">At MOIA we’re reimagining the future of mobility – safe, autonomous and tailored to the needs of cities and their people. As a tech company with more than 400 employees, we build mobility solutions that truly move cities forward.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">We launched our ridepooling service in Hamburg in 2019 and have been part of the city’s public transport system since 2023. Since launch, we have transported over 12 million passengers. Currently, MOIA is evolving from a mobility provider to a tech provider offering a scalable and safe <a href="https://youtu.be/POHpzaR965A?si=Dbd_GzWjWyPLS_JV" target="_blank">turnkey solution for autonomous driving</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">With office locations in Berlin and Hamburg, our diverse and international team comprising more than 60 nationalities works together toward that shared mission.&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">MOIA is more than a technology provider – we are a partner to cities and public transport operators committed to creating more livable spaces and delivering mobility solutions that are reliable, safe and comfortable.</p> <h2 style="text-align: justify;">Your application to MOIA</h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">We value authenticity and personal insights in your application responses. While AI tools can be useful, we encourage you to answer the following questions based on your own experiences and understanding. This helps us keep a human touch and better evaluate your unique perspective and match for the role.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">To reinforce an unbiased screening process, we kindly ask you not to include your picture, age, address, or any other details unrelated to your qualifications and suitability for the role. Additionally, we anonymize applications during the initial review phase by removing personally identifiable information. This ensures that our evaluation focuses solely on your skills, experience, and potential – supporting a fair and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Finance Solutions
raw.description:
Unser Kunde ist ein spezialisierter Anbieter für Business Intelligence, Unternehmensplanung und Konzernkonsolidierung und begleitet seit vielen Jahren Unternehmen vom Mittelstand bis zum internationalen Konzern bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Finanzprozesse. Im Fokus stehen ganzheitliche Lösungen rund um Reporting, Planung, Forecasting und Konsolidierung auf Basis moderner BI Technologien. 
Gesucht wird ein Senior Consultant, der Finance Verständnis, Beratungskompetenz und analytisches Denken verbindet. In dieser Rolle begleitest du Kunden langfristig bei der Optimierung ihrer Finanz- und Controllingprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen moderne BI- und Planungslösungen. 

Dich erwartet eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, direktem Kundenkontakt und langfristigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem spezialisierten Consulting Umfeld. 

Deine Benefits

  • Je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung erwartet dich ein attraktives Gesamtpaket 

  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit direktem Einfluss auf Kundenprojekte und Unternehmensentwicklung 

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Freie Zeiteinteilung orientiert am Kundenbedarf sowie 2-3 Tage Home Office 

  • Remote Möglichkeit: Auch deutschlandweite Remote Zusammenarbeit möglich, abhängig von Wohnort und Reisetätigkeit 

  • Langfristige Entwicklungsperspektive: Möglichkeit zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung bis hin zur Teamführung oder strategischen Rolle im Unternehmen 

  • Spannende Kundenprojekte: Zusammenarbeit mit namhaften Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen im Bereich BI, Planung und Konsolidierung 

  • Mentoring und Wissenstransfer: Enger Austausch im kleinen Team mit direkter Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Spezialisten 

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Grünes Büro mit Terrasse, Küche und angenehmer Arbeitsatmosphäre 

  • Mobilitätsangebote: Firmenparkplatz, Bike Leasing sowie je nach Rolle Firmenwagen möglich 

  • Starkes Teamgefühl: Kleine Teams, kurze Entscheidungswege und regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten 

Deine Aufgaben als Senior Consultant

  • Beratung und Betreuung von Kunden im Bereich Business Intelligence, Unternehmensplanung und Konzernkonsolidierung 

  • Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Finance, Controlling und Konzernrechnungswesen 

  • Entwicklung von Konzepten und Lösungsarchitekturen auf Basis von IBM Planning Analytics TM1 

  • Übersetzung betriebswirtschaftlicher Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und Systemkonzepte 

  • Modellierung und Implementierung von OLAP Lösungen, Reports, Dashboards und Planungssystemen 

  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von Datenintegrationen aus ERP, Finanz- und Vorsystemen 

  • Begleitung von Kundenprojekten von der Konzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme 

  • Durchführung von Workshops, Anwenderschulungen und Präsentationen beim Kunden 

  • Langfristige Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenlösungen 

  • Unterstützung bei Presales Aktivitäten, Lösungskonzepten und Kundenpräsentationen

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Finance, Controlling oder vergleichbare Studiengänge 

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Business Intelligence, Finanzplanung und Konzernkonsolidierung 

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Budgetierung, Forecasting sowie Reporting und Controlling Prozessen 

  • Praxis in der Analyse und Optimierung von Finance- und Controlling Prozessen 

  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie souveränes Auftreten im Austausch mit Kunden und Fachbereichen 

  • Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung 

  • Interesse an datengetriebenen Lösungen sowie Verständnis für BI- und Planungssysteme 

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse für die optimale Kundenberatung und Kommunikation im Team

  • Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Workshops (ca. 1x im Monat) 
    Nice to Have: 

  • Erfahrung mit IBM Planning Analytics TM1 

Du möchtest Unternehmen nicht nur beraten, sondern aktiv dabei unterstützen, moderne Finanz- und BI-Lösungen aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln? 
Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Consultant BI & Konsolidierung!

Für den weiteren Ausbau der Data & Analytics Landschaft wird eine Persönlichkeit gesucht, die moderne Datenarchitekturen entwickelt und den Weg zu einer datengetriebenen Organisation aktiv mitgestaltet 

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.  

  • Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.  

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.  

  • Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.  

  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.  

  • Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.  

  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer entwickelst und betreibst du moderne Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Daten zuverlässig für Analysen, Reporting und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen bereitstehen. 

  • Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse.  

  • Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen.  

  • Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows.  

  • Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow.  

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. 

Dein Profil als Data Engineer

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen.  

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services, insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python, insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen.  

  • Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  

  • Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.  

  • Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt.  

Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt:

  • Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen.  

  • Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld.  

  • Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen.  

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps.  

  • Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen.  

  • Erfahrung mit Openbridge. 

Die Rolle als Data Engineer klingt genau nach dir? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen Telefonat alle weiteren Infos zu Stelle und Unternehmen.

Location: Hybrid, Munich

Team & Reporting line:  Imaging Operations/Mission Planning Unit, Reporting to the Image Operations Lead.

Our Mission 

At constellr, we're harnessing the power of space to solve one of Earth’s greatest challenges: climate resilience & security in a changing world. Our thermal satellite constellation delivers the most accurate land surface temperature data on the market, equipping commercial players, governments, defence agencies, and global institutions with the thermal intelligence they need to make strategic decisions– from national security and infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience. 
 
As a fast-scaling company with offices in Brussels, Freiburg, Munich, Washington and Toulouse, our multidisciplinary team of engineers, scientists, and strategists is building the future of space-based Earth observation.

Your Role:

As our Mission Planning Software Engineer, you will shape the software systems that enable automated, scalable mission planning for our satellite constellation. Working at the intersection of space operations and software engineering, you will transform mission objectives and operational constraints into reliable planning systems that power daily satellite activity. You will collaborate across operations and product teams to define how missions are planned and executed at scale, supporting the evolution from manual workflows to a unified, automated platform that directly drives satellite command and imaging execution. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build core mission planning services and algorithms that power mission planning applications for a growing satellite constellation 

  • Shape the architecture and design of mission planning systems to ensure scalability, reliability, and long-term operability 

  • Run, monitor, and maintain mission planning systems in live production environments 

  • Define engineering standards for reliability, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, safety, and operational compliance 

  • Collaborate across Flight Operations, Flight Dynamics, Payload, Satellite Operations, and Product leadership to turn mission needs into technical direction and system design 

  • Drive adoption of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and robust deployment practices across mission-critical systems 

  • Translate mission requests into executable satellite telecommands, including interaction with the telecommand database 

  • Align mission plans with onboard scheduling and execution constraints to ensure feasible satellite operations 


About you 

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field 

  • 3–5+ years of experience in software engineering, space systems engineering, satellite operations software, or ground segment development 

  • Strong experience building production-grade distributed systems, backend services, or mission-critical software 

  • Experience designing or working with mission planning, scheduling, automation, or orchestration systems in complex operational environments 

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Java, SQL, and containerised application development. 

  • Proven experience developing reliable, scalable software for production environments with a strong focus on correctness, robustness, and maintainability 

  • Familiarity with Linux environments and operating services in production (deployment, debugging, performance tuning) 

  • Experience with infrastructure components such as AWS, CI/CD pipelines, containerised deployments, and service orchestration

  • Ability to design and debug complex systems involving multiple services, data flows, and external operational dependencies 

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Imaging Operations, Flight Operations, product and engineering teams 

  • High level of ownership, autonomy, and attention to detail in mission- or safety-critical contexts 

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where systems evolve quickly, and operational reliability is essential 

Nice to Have: 

  • Prior exposure to satellite operations environments or ground segment toolchains; particularly satellite tasking, commanding, and on-board schedule (plan) generation.

  • Experience with real-time systems or high-reliability distributed systems. 

  • Experience with data systems and observability tooling (e.g., PostgreSQL, time-series databases, Grafana, logging/monitoring stacks). 

  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and Django for server-side web application development. 

  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Terramate) and automated configuration management using Ansible. 

  • Ability to build full-stack web applications with Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 

  • Experience managing cloud infrastructure on AWS. 

  • Theoretical and applied background in AI planning and optimisation, including PDDL formulation, constraint satisfaction, Markov decision processes, and combinatorial optimisation algorithms. 

  • Practical experience integrating automated planning and optimisation algorithms into real-world software systems. 

  • Experience in event-driven software architecture design and implementation. 

  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration using Kubernetes. 

Why join constellr?

  • High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies.

  • Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match.

  • Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers.

  • Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy.

roadmap with clear business and customer value-based measures of success.</li> <li>Advise clients on becoming a value-driven, customer-centric product organisation and drive the change by introducing best practices in product management, value delivery and measurement and making innovation mainstream.</li> <li>Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Skilled at operating and building relationships with C-suite and can operate with ambiguity.</li> <li>Bias for action, and can break down complex problems into tangible steps.</li> <li>Enjoy collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and can operate as an advisory but also as a hands on practitioner.</li> <li>Passionate about creating thought-leadership and representing our brand and value proposition in external events, and by writing articles or We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.  Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks. Lead day-to-day compliance workstreams covering sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, privacy, healthcare, employment, and product-related regulations Support internal investigations, audits,   • Modern facilities including a dedicated theatre, separate prep area, digital radiography, dental x-ray and a new ultrasound scanner
  • Separate cat ward, isolation facilities and excellent staff amenities
  • Part of a supportive three-practice network alongside our Stokesley and Copeland clinics, offering additional clinical support and expertise

  • Friendly, highly experienced nursing and client care team with a strong culture of teamwork and knowledge sharing
 

How You'll Make a Difference

 

As a Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you'll play a key role in delivering exceptional patient care while supporting the development of the wider clinical team.

  • Help foster a positive, supportive and collaborative clinical culture

Working Pattern

  • Full-time position
  • 40 hours across four days
  • Shared Saturday rota
  • Flexible working discussions welcomed

Located on the edge of the stunning North York Moors, Guisborough offers the perfect blend of countryside, coastline, and community living. With beautiful walking routes, easy access to the Yorkshire coast, and excellent transport links into Middlesbrough, York, and Newcastle, the area provides a fantastic quality of life both in and out of work.

We are a fast-growing pet care e-commerce business specializing in pet prescription medicines, pet food, and accessories. As we expand, our focus remains on delivering excellent customer service, ensuring exceptional regulatory compliance, and driving massive efficiency gains across our operations.
As Operations Director, you will be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team, responsible for the end-to-end operations of our business. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will oversee critical operational functions, ensuring they run efficiently, effectively, and in alignment with our ambitious growth strategy

The Operations Director will lead the operational strategy for Pet Drugs Online, focusing on the provision of excellent customer service, regulatory compliance, the delivery of an increasingly efficient operation. This role requires a strategic leader with a deep understanding of e-commerce logistical and customer operations and ideally the pet healthcare market.

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities:

Customer Contact Centre Operations
* Lead and develop a high-performing customer service team, ensuring fast response times and high customer satisfaction.

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as response time, customer retention, and Net Promoter Score (NPS).

Logistics & Delivery Management
* Manage and optimise partnerships with third-party logistics providers and couriers.
* Negotiate contracts and service level agreements (SLAs) to improve delivery speed and reduce costs.

* Establish and maintain strong relationships with multiple courier providers to ensure reliable and cost-effective shipping solutions.

Building Maintenance & Facilities Management
* Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of warehouse and office facilities.

* Plan for future expansion needs, ensuring facilities can scale with the company’s growth.

Health & Safety Compliance
* Implement and maintain workplace health and safety policies in line with legal requirements.

About Numan 
 
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
 
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
 
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 
 
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
 
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The role: 

 This role is about taking our platform to the next level: moving toward sophisticated, predictive, and learning-based decisioning, with a clear path toward becoming a regulated medical device.

This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor (IC) role for someone who combines deep system understanding with clinical product judgement and real experience deploying AI/ML. You are AI-enabled, well-resourced, and measure your success by what you ship and move, rather than the size of your team. You move comfortably between high-level strategy and engineering-grade specifics.


You'll be:

  • Lead the product direction and roadmap for the decision platform, from long-term strategy down to the detail of how a rule actually works.

  • Decide which features and capabilities create the most scalable value, balancing near-term execution with strategic bets.

  • Establish and systematically track the success metrics for the platform.

    • Set the direction for how the platform uses AI and machine learning, embedding predictive and supervised learning systems into production.

    • Build self-learning systems so the platform continuously improves on its historical recommendations while keeping safety and explainability central.

    • Read and reason about system architecture. Act as a credible equal in technical debates with engineers, making sharp trade-offs between speed-to-value and long-term scalability.

      • Help shape the product side of the platform's regulatory direction, including the decision to build it as Software/AI as a Medical Device (SaMD).

      • Work fluently with sensitive patient data, partnering with clinical and quality colleagues to ensure safety and patient trust fundamentally shape the roadmap.

        • Proactively show engineering, clinical, design, and other product teams what the platform makes possible, while staying pragmatic about what they can absorb today.

  • A proven track record as a Senior or Principal Technical PM on complex platform, infrastructure, or systems products.

  • Hands-on experience deploying machine learning in production, specifically supervised learning or predictive systems.

  • Experience deploying or regulating software/AI as a medical device (SaMD), or working within closely comparable regulated frameworks.

  • Direct experience working with rules engines, knowledge graphs, or AI-driven decisioning systems.

  • Experience in clinical, healthcare, or adjacent domains handling sensitive, highly detailed user data.

title: SVP, Data & Tech Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>2830 - SVP, Data &amp; Tech Lead - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><em>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. WPP Media is WPP's global media collective, bringing together the best platforms, people, and partners to create limitless opportunities for growth in a world where media is Everywhere.&nbsp; </em></p> <p>This role is within the Data, Tech, and Analytics (DTA) team, within the Global Client Solutions organisation. The Global Client Solutions (GCS) team is responsible for all global clients within WPP. DTA is responsible for servicing clients with best-in-class data solutions, data strategy, analytics, technology and AI solutions to drive client growth. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection.</p> <p><strong>SVP, Data &amp; Tech Lead</strong></p> <p>As the Global Client Data &amp; Tech Lead, you will take ownership of driving data-led transformation for one of WPP’s largest and most ambitious global clients. You will be at the forefront of enabling data, technology, and AI to create more impactful brand experiences and measurable business growth.</p> <p>You will be a strategic partner to WPP Media’s Global Client Leads, defining what ‘data-driven’ marketing looks like for your client across Discovery, Planning, Activation, and Measurement. You will act as a senior advisor to CMOs and other key stakeholders and will guide them in building the data capabilities and infrastructure needed to achieve their marketing goals while ensuring responsible and effective use of data.</p> <p>This role demands a leader who can combine thought leadership, operational expertise, strong line management, and a deep understanding of data and technology to deliver tangible results. You will assemble and lead a team of experts to implement strategies, deploy solutions, and build long-term capability for your client.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Client Data Narrative &amp; Drive Growth:</strong> Build strategic relationships with key client stakeholders, including CMOs, IT, and Finance leaders. Develop a deep understanding of client objectives and advise on how data, technology, and AI can drive impact and growth. Act as a trusted advisor, helping clients navigate complex challenges and opportunities in data-driven marketing. Partner with the Global Account Director/Client President to co-create and execute the Global Client Growth Plan.</li> <li><strong>Data Strategy Expertise:</strong> Assemble and lead a team of data strategists to define the role of data for media and advertising on the client business. Define how first-party data should be collected, organized, and deployed across business units. Identify and execute data partnerships to enrich and extend first-party data. Standardize data usage across markets and business units to achieve marketing objectives.</li> <li><strong>Measurement &amp; Optimization Frameworks:</strong> Oversee the design and implementation of measurement frameworks that balance short- and long-term value creation. Define growth targets and metrics for marketing effectiveness. Define and deploy use of data science techniques to better predict growth from audience-based, omnichannel approaches. Introduce AI-powered optimization tools to enhance efficiency and performance within and across channels. Ensure timely and actionable reporting for visibility into performance.</li> <li><strong>Technology Consulting and Implementation</strong>: Assemble and lead a team to evaluate clients’ technology ecosystems and recommend improvements to enhance performance and reduce costs. Oversee the implementation of cloud data management, martech, adtech, AI, and analytics systems. Integrate WPP Data, Tech, and media solutions into the client’s broader technology stack to accelerate results.</li> <li><strong>Capability Building and Education</strong>: Educate WPP client teams on WPP’s data capabilities, tools, and priorities. Provide visible leadership, coaching, and mentorship to inspire teams and foster innovation in data, technology, and AI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL NEED</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relevant industry experience, including significant time in an agency environment.</li> <li>Proven experience operating at a senior client leadership level or engaging with high-profile stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated thought leadership and expertise in data, technology, and AI within the marketing industry.</li> <li>A track record of solving complex problems and delivering measurable business success through data-driven strategies.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence teams, clients, and colleagues positively.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills, capable of simplifying complex concepts for diverse audiences.</li> <li>Experience building and managing large, diverse teams of data, technology, and analytics specialists.</li> <li>Strategic and operational agility, with the ability to adapt quickly in dynamic environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also&nbsp;Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and&nbsp;Championing Growth and Development&nbsp;for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We&nbsp;Create an Open environment&nbsp;built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when&nbsp;we're&nbsp;together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbsp;That's&nbsp;why&nbsp;we’ve&nbsp;adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you&nbsp;require&nbsp;accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp; Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3048 - Director, Planning, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>EssenceMediacom, part of WPP, is a new breed of media agency. Grounded in analytics &amp; insights and powered by data &amp; technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data &amp; technology, built for people &amp; algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test &amp; learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>In this role you will work across the EE/BT consumer account, focusing on EE’s brand activity across a variety of products including Mobile, Broadband, TV and Gaming, as well as Masterbrand.</p> <p><strong>Position/Title: Business Director - Brand</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a highly experienced, smart planner who loves both new ideas and the craft.&nbsp; EE/BT is one of the biggest advertisers in the UK, so our benchmark is not work that’s merely good enough - it has to be great.</p> <p><strong>Practice Summary:</strong></p> <p>As planners we’re the conductors of the orchestra that is paid [and beyond] media.&nbsp; We work collaboratively with Strategy and Activation to ensure our approach is fully integrated across POES.&nbsp; We search for insight and intelligence so that we can build innovative media plans, owning the process and incorporating cross-channel budget allocation, in-flight cross-channel optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis. We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns.</p> <p><strong>Position Summary:</strong></p> <p>The Business Director will oversee media campaigns with support from more junior planners and assist the Client Lead in ensuring our work is delivered to the highest quality. They will be responsible for elevating our agency's strategic planning function through a robust, data-first approach. This role is key to integrating advanced analytical capabilities with creative strategic development, ensuring our recommendations are always evidence-based and ahead of the curve. They will demonstrate a thorough knowledge of the overall media landscape and available research, using these to inform and communicate planning recommendations. The Business Director has oversight and responsibility for the day-to-day management of media plans, working to fulfill the client’s media strategy in the context of changing market conditions. They are responsible for ensuring investment is optimal to deliver campaign objectives, via effective planning.</p> <p><strong>Our clients:</strong></p> <p>We work across the EE/BT group.&nbsp; Although their public faces are very different, the two brands are managed very closely together.&nbsp; They’re one of the nation’s biggest spenders, and some of our most-loved brands.&nbsp; They are genuinely important to the nation with their creation and management of the UK’s connectivity networks, and we reflect that importance with how we try to help consumers and give them useful solutions in a modern world.</p> <p><strong>Our team:</strong></p> <p>Team Connect is a very big team that is 100% allocated to EE, BT and Plusnet.&nbsp; A successful candidate can expect to work on multiple aspects of these brands. This includes broadband, mobile, TV, as well as Masterbrand. This role is purely Brand focused but will involve close collaboration with Performance planners.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Essential Functions/Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain fantastic relationships with key clients in media and marketing teams.</li> <li>Ensure the delivery of high-quality response presentations, actionable weekly reporting, insightful post campaign analyses and clear briefs to Activation.</li> <li>Deliver clear and compelling rationale to support media investment recommendations and to evidence campaign performance versus expected outcomes.</li> <li>Spearhead the integration of data analytics and insights into the core of our strategic planning processes, ensuring data is used proactively and upfront in all client engagements and internal initiatives.</li> <li>Accelerate AI adoption and transformation across the team, ensuring we are regularly sharing work and that clients see the tangible benefits of WPP Open.</li> <li>Take a lead role in developing and presenting best-in-class Strategic Response to Briefs (RTBs).</li> <li>Support ADs in delivering Media Detail RTBs and in briefing Activation teams.</li> <li>Work closely with the Head of Strategy &amp; Planning on wider cross-portfolio strategic workstreams.</li> <li>Oversee and quality assure all deliverables produced by junior team members.</li> <li>Work with Activation and Analytics in the delivery and measurement of plans.</li> <li>Take responsibility for the performance of assigned media budgets against intended outcomes.</li> <li>Be a point of escalation for team issues (within and outside the team).</li> <li>Contribute to internal thought leadership and team process/workflow enhancement, to increase work quality and efficiency.</li> <li>Line-manage 3 direct reports (AD, AM, SAE), supporting their career development and driving job satisfaction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies (specific knowledge, skills and abilities)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced knowledge of media landscape, media metric calculations and measurement techniques.</li> <li>Thorough understanding of industry standard media research tools (ComScore, Touchpoints, TGI, YouGov).</li> <li>Demonstrable expertise in understanding, interpreting, and applying various data sources (e.g., market research, digital analytics, social listening, econometrics, CRM data, first-party data).</li> <li>Deep understanding of current market trends, consumer behaviour, and the evolving media landscape.</li> <li>Superb client relationship and management skills.</li> <li>Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and insights into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences. (internal teams, clients, senior leadership).</li> <li>Highly collaborative, comfortable working cross-functionally with data, analytics, research, and creative teams.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading, inspiring, and upskilling more junior planners, fostering a culture of curiosity and continuous learning.</li> <li>Excellent organisational skills, close attention to detail and ability to quality-control work.</li> <li>Forecast expected outcomes of brand and performance campaigns and manage investment accordingly.</li> <li>Basic spreadsheet capabilities (VLOOKUP, Pivot Table) are a must.</li> <li>Superior presentation design skills, in slides or document format.</li> <li>Ability to adhere to deadlines and project manage multiple campaigns.</li> <li>Development and maintenance of productive relationships with media owner partners.</li> <li>Proven problem solving and decision-making skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and to collaborate in a team environment.</li> <li>Skilled in quantitative reasoning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Management Responsibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Motivate a team, leading by example while coaching juniors - cultivating a dynamic and inquisitive culture where hypothesis-driven thinking is central to problem-solving.</li> <li>Provide timely and actionable feedback to aid in team development and improvement.</li> <li>Monitor and support satisfaction across the team, identifying and implementing ways to maintain or increase satisfaction.</li> <li>Foster strong working relationships across the team to facilitate flawless execution of plans.</li> <li>Communicate effectively across all levels of the team, understanding when to escalate issues to leadership.</li> <li>Calculate the workload implication of new campaigns and feed into resource management.</li> <li>Provide awareness and recognition for jobs well done.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Education and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least six to eight years of experience in a pure planning role.</li> <li>Demonstrable interest and expertise in planning craft.</li> <li>Data literate with demonstrable expertise in understanding, interpreting, and applying various data sources.</li> <li>Mastery of planning/insight tools such as eTelmar, TGI, YouGov, WARC, etc.</li> <li>Strong experience and interest in dedicated planning tools.</li> <li>Interest and knowledge of Planning and Media trends and issues.</li> <li>Proven experience in media at Senior Manager level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp;</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location.</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide.&nbsp;</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
